The '''Blastfield Shipyards''' was a massive complex located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The complex was dedicated to the construction of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Two of the ship classes they were known to produce were the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] and the [[Valor-class cruiser]].
